prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 家常红烧肉配料表 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 4 columns × 9 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Per-column content facts (content px at 13px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "食材" · longest unbreakable word 14px · one-line width 40px
  col 2: header "用量（克）" · longest unbreakable word 40px · one-line width 67px
  col 3: header "处理方式" · longest unbreakable word 27px · one-line width 208px
  col 4: header "备注" · longest unbreakable word 27px · one-line width 160px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 480px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 479px.
Fixed: content, font, 13px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"A kitchen reference card: eight ingredients for 家常红烧肉, each with a quantity and a short prep instruction plus an advisory note. It is consulted mid-cooking, not read as prose, so lookup speed and unambiguous quantities matter more than compactness.","reading":"Vertical scan down col 1 to locate an ingredient, then a short rightward hop to its amount, then the prep instruction, then optionally the note. Comparison happens down the amount column (500 vs 15 vs 5) and across the two prose columns, which are read only one row at a time. Rows are the unit, so every row should keep its four cells visually on the same band and prose should wrap rather than push a row apart.","groups":["col 1 + col 2: ingredient and its quantity are one measure unit ('what' + 'how much') and must be read together, so they should stay narrow and adjacent with no wrapping between them","col 3 + col 4: both are free prose; 处理方式 is the operative instruction, 备注 is secondary/advisory, so they may be traded against each other but not against cols 1–2"],"keep_intact":["ingredient names in col 1 (五花肉, 大葱, 冰糖 …) — never break a 2–3 character name","all amounts in col 2: 500, 15, 20, 25, 30, 5 and the words 适量 / 少许 must sit on one line","the header 用量（克） should stay unbroken so the unit is not orphaned from the number it qualifies","numeral+unit tokens inside prose such as 3厘米 and 两次 should not be split mid-token"],"may_wrap":["处理方式 sentences (切3厘米见方块，冷水下锅焯净血沫 / 焯水和炖煮时分两次加入) — 2 lines is acceptable","备注 sentences (选肥瘦三层分明的五花肉 / 老姜去腥效果更好) — advisory, can absorb 2–3 lines without hurting the lookup","the header 处理方式 / 备注 may wrap only as a last resort; both fit at 27px unbreakable"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r1A: widths [61, 88, 172, 158] · table 480×360px · row heights [33, 53, 33, 53, 53, 33, 33, 33, 33] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1B: widths [61, 88, 180, 150] · table 480×400px · row heights [33, 53, 33, 53, 53, 33, 33, 53, 53] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1C: widths [61, 88, 166, 164] · table 480×380px · row heights [33, 53, 33, 53, 53, 33, 33, 53, 33] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r1A","good":"食材、用量和表头都保持单行；处理方式与备注的分配也较均衡。只有三条食材行增高，其余行紧凑，逐行查找和横向读取都比较顺畅。","problems":"五花肉的处理方式和备注都换行，大葱和冰糖的备注末尾也各有一小段落到第二行，文字节奏略显零碎。","cause":"处理方式宽172px、备注宽158px，均不足以容纳这些较长句子；可用宽度又受前两列单行需求约束。"},{"design":"r1B","good":"处理方式增加到180px后，操作说明有更宽裕的阅读空间；食材、用量和表头仍保持单行。","problems":"备注列明显偏窄，料酒和盐的备注也被迫换行，增加了两条高行；表格变长，但处理方式并未减少需要换行的行数。","cause":"从备注列转出8px，使其降至150px；这跨过了两条备注的单行容纳阈值。"},{"design":"r1C","good":"备注列增至164px，盐的备注可保持单行；各表头和用量仍完整。","problems":"料酒的处理方式末尾单独落下一字，形成醒目的短尾行，并使该行增高；相比r1A，备注的增宽没有带来足够的行高收益。","cause":"处理方式降至166px，低于料酒操作说明保持单行所需的宽度；备注从158px增至164px则未消除r1A中已有的高行。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"r2A","widths":[61,88,173,157],"change":"以r1A为基础，将1px从备注移给处理方式，检查能否改善操作说明的断行，同时保住备注中料酒和盐的单行。"},{"name":"r2B","widths":[61,88,171,159],"change":"从r1A向备注移动1px，探索备注的断行阈值，并检查料酒处理方式能否继续保持单行。"}]}
